table.seed: fast rungs at the middle of the rung; slow rungs on the tallest line within 30 % of the pot's speed over its first 4000 rows tracked over the fast rungs' table's local counts a cycle; a slow rung at [(1.8, 2.2), (0.45, 0.55)] of a fast rung's cycles set aside

source.pot: pot counts a ripple cycle on each slow rung the table read, read again over its whole drive on the line the table read was seeded on; r the counts over the pass's median over its cycles more than inner_margin_counts inside both stops; a hole where r > 1 + far_k s, s the noise_percentile of |r - 1| over those inner cycles; flagged cycles merge_gap_cycles apart on a rung, and holes from any rungs within touch_counts, are one; degrees from the low stop through the run's table over its counts_per_deg, shaft_deg the cycles x 360 over the nameplate's brushes x rotor_segments x gear_ratio
